fixes_verified.name: Future-mark rejection
fixes_verified.description: cycle() now checks closed_mark.observed_at > cycle.now or closed_mark.available_at > cycle.now and raises SupervisedPaperPerformanceError('future or unavailable mark evidence'). Accounting bytes remain unchanged. Equality boundaries (observed_at == cycle.now, available_at == cycle.now) accepted.

fixes_verified.name: Startup reconciliation
fixes_verified.description: start() now calls ledger.reconcile_gateway(adapter.gateway) before initialize, which detects fill mismatches. Missing performance checkpoint with retained gateway fills rejects with SupervisedPaperPerformanceError('startup reconciliation failed'). Gateway fill evidence preserved. Durable halt activated.

fixes_verified.name: PaperPerformanceHaltUnconfirmedError + latched coordinator
fixes_verified.description: PaperPerformanceHaltUnconfirmedError raised when halt write fails. Coordinator latches via _failed flag; _assert_not_failed() rejects further start/cycle with 'latched' error.
